project.title: Stitch
project.description: Resource pack shaders that keep working under shader packs: brings a pack's armour and model effects back under Iris and OptiFine.

gallery.title: Five armour sets under Complementary
gallery.description: Five armour sets from the showcase pack under the Complementary shader pack at sunset. Every effect is a resource pack stitch.

gallery.title: With and without Stitch
gallery.description: Vanilla with the effects; a shader pack without Stitch, the armour plain; a shader pack with Stitch, the effects back.

gallery.title: Astral
gallery.description: Each panel is a window onto a starfield fixed in the world. The pieces float free of the body.

gallery.title: Magma
gallery.description: Lava flows down the cracks in basalt plate, embers glow beside it, and the suit shimmers with heat.

gallery.title: Glitch
gallery.description: Slices tear sideways, colours split, scanlines crawl and the circuits pulse.

gallery.title: Seraph
gallery.description: Great feathered wings that beat, folded out of the chestplate's own faces.

gallery.title: Phantom
gallery.description: Spectral mail that drifts, and burns away at glowing edges as it fades in and out.

gallery.title: On a player
gallery.description: Wings, shadows and all: the stitches follow the body's pose like any armour.
